request: Continue every configuration whose existing six-scene mean position Q is below the same-scene RBF baseline; train and screen them using the same method, without a Plant-start cap.

training_method.dataset: reuse the accepted teacher-only full split: 1536 TRAIN runs and 96 VAL runs
training_method.schedule: the frozen official 40000-step gate with 2000-step evaluations; apply the existing uniform 60000-step extension rule if any fit improves by at least 1% from its best through 30000 to its best in steps 30001-40000
training_method.initialization: fresh initialization per model and seed; no B, Initial, Final, or History weights

screening_method.selection: retain finite, complete, stable groups and compare equal-weight mean position Q; report same-scene B alongside every result

selection_rule_supersedes: The earlier X20 extension requirement to match the incumbent model is replaced for this authorized extension by the user's explicit below-RBF eligibility rule.
